items.title: Unity acquires 3D asset creator Synty Studios; artist-created content to be integrated into AI game-creation platform Unity Spark
items.excerpt: Unity bought Synty Studios, maker of the widely used low-poly asset packs. Synty's artist-made library (70,000+ assets per other reports) will feed Unity Spark, its AI game-creation platform, and Synty keeps the 'same brand, same artists, and same style.'
items.rationale: A major engine maker is buying one of the most widely used artist-made asset libraries to feed its AI game-creation tool. This directly affects the asset pipelines of the many indies who already use Synty packs.

items.title: miHoYo、ゲームを遊ぶAIの研究成果を公開。AIがゲーム画面を見てキーボード＆マウスを操作―『崩壊：スターレイル』などで検証
items.excerpt: On November 13 miHoYo's research team posted an arXiv paper on 'Gamer', a general-purpose agent that reads the game screen and plays with keyboard and mouse. It is built on Qwen3-VL (8B), trained on tens of thousands of hours of play logs, and was tested on Honkai: Star Rail side quests and minigames plus DOOM-style environments.
items.rationale: New research from a major studio: miHoYo's 'Gamer' agent plays games from the screen pixels, with obvious uses in QA and playtesting automation. It was validated on a shipped live-service title.

items.title: Ashes of the Singularity 2 review: Some neat ideas undermined by a rubbish campaign and obtrusive generative AI
items.excerpt: PC Gamer says Stardock and Oxide's RTS sequel is 'overshadowed by the spectre of generative AI'. Per the game's Steam disclosure, AI added post-processing and animation to human-made art in campaign cutscenes and composited human-made 3D assets, and the review says that use is most obvious in the story.
items.rationale: A real-world test of how critics score a commercial release that uses disclosed gen-AI cutscene processing. It is a concrete warning for art teams thinking about the same shortcut.

items.title: Are the new wave of solo AI game-makers making any money? No, not really
items.excerpt: Creator interviews show most solo games built with tools like Claude Code earn almost nothing: Sprout made about $6 from 121 downloads and Calc Quest about $120 from 25k players. One outlier, 38-0-0, passed 1M downloads. (Off-list outlet; none of the on-list sources covered AI-game store revenue.)
items.rationale: This piece reports actual store revenue for solo vibe-coded games, from about $6 for most up to one hit with 1M+ downloads. That kind of data is rare and grounds the 'anyone can ship a game' hype.

items.title: Steamへのリリース手数料、25倍の約40万円にすべき？AIゲームの大量投稿と審査遅延に解決策はあるのか…インディー業界の2人が言及
items.excerpt: On their show, Mike Rose (No More Robots) and Rami Ismail blamed the flood of generative-AI games for doubling Steam releases to about 3,600 a month. They floated raising the $100 Steam Direct fee 25x to $2,500 and cited a survey in which 92% of 100 studios use AI in some form.
items.rationale: Two prominent indie figures propose a specific fix for the AI-game flood on Steam: raising the Steam Direct fee 25x to $2,500. They back it with fresh numbers (about 3,600 releases a month; 92% of 100 studios use AI).
